### Xenia Hotels & Resorts Announces Timing of Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call


September 10, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/643842295/files/doc_news/2026/09/Q3-2026-ER-Date.pdf)


ORLANDO, Fla.


, Sept. 10, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Xenia Hotels & Resorts, Inc. (NYSE: XHR) ("Xenia" or the "Company") will report financial results for the third quarter 2026 before the market opens on Tuesday, November 3, 2026. Management will discuss the Company's results during a conference call at 1:00 pm (Eastern Time) that day.


To participate in the conference call, please follow the steps listed below:


Tuesday, November 3, 2026, dial (833) 461-5787 approximately ten minutes before the call begins, Meeting ID: 953 553 378.


Tell the operator that you are calling for Xenia Hotels & Resorts' Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Conference Call.


State your full name and company affiliation and you will be connected to the call.


A live webcast of the earnings call will also be available through the Company's website. To access, log on to[www.xeniareit.com](http://www.xeniareit.com/) ten minutes prior to the call. A replay of the conference call webcast will be archived and available online for 90 days through the Investor Relations section of[www.xeniareit.com](http://www.xeniareit.com/) .


**About Xenia Hotels & Resorts, Inc.**


Xenia Hotels & Resorts, Inc. is a self-advised and self-administered REIT that invests in uniquely positioned luxury and upper upscale hotels and resorts with a focus on the top 25 lodging markets as well as key leisure destinations in the United States. The Company owns 29 hotels comprising 8,783 rooms across 14 states. Xenia's hotels are in the luxury and upper upscale segments, and operated and/or licensed by industry leaders such as Marriott, Hyatt, Kimpton, Fairmont, Loews, Hilton, and Davidson. For more information on Xenia's business, refer to the Company website at[www.xeniareit.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4770320-1&h=1869036452&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.xeniareit.com%2F&a=www.xeniareit.com) .
